title: Unlocking the Power to Create Wealth and Multiply Abundance
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals a bold vision for The River Church of Kansas City - a vision of prosperity, wealth, and meeting the physical needs of the community. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris shares a plan to see the church flourish and become a beacon of hope and blessing to the city. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge you to believe for the impossible and trust in God's goodness.
